chunks: Abu Khadijah Salim ibn Mukrim al-Jammal narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام that he said:

"Give zakat to whoever from Banu Hashim seeks it, for it is permissible for them. It is prohibited only for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, for the Imam after him, and for the Imams عليهم السلام."

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat, the obligatory alms-tax being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam who succeeds the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.بَنِي هَاشِمٍ: the clan of Banu Hashim, the family group mentioned as recipients

ai.seo_question: Is zakat permissible for Banu Hashim in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the permissibility of zakat for members of Banu Hashim. It states that zakat is lawful for them if they seek it, while specifically excluding the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Imams عليهم السلام from receiving it.
